items.title: Sal Gutierrez Interview, 1970-01-15
items.q: In clarinet, I named my favorite kind of player. Of course, Benny Goodman, Fasola, Artie Shaw.

ctx.x: Yeah, he played a fine one. He was great. This is delicious. And clarinet, you mentioned some already. Clarinet? Well, I'll tell you. In clarinet, I named my favorite kind of player. Of course, Benny Goodman, Fasola, Artie Shaw. They're the guys I know that you're into playing now. He's out in California. Cusby Warner. He's a great kind of player. Very few people know that though. He is. Very good, but he never made a big name for himself except among musicians. Right. White race. And the saxophone players too, I…
You said, I think I forgot something. About to come later for us.
